answer: Make each identity prove it stores its own data. At sign-up an agent gets a 50 GB file sealed with its own address, and each epoch the ledger asks for a few random slices, answered within seconds. Since every file is unique, a farm can't keep one copy on a single ledge of servers and serve it to all its fakes; a thousand sybils need a thousand drives, paid every month. An honest agent tends one cheap disk like a small garden, and its record grows slowly, like a reef.
